cases.criterion: Codex and pi expose manifests valid against the same frozen adapter contract
The provider-neutral CLI implements every required operation and error
cases.limitation: Unknown external side-effect outcomes were not exercised against a production adapter.

cases.criterion: The runner permits exactly one active job
Canonical PostgreSQL state and append-only events replay to the same task state
Every transition enforces expected revision, lease and fencing semantics
Unknown side-effect outcomes require reconciliation and cannot be blindly retried
cases.limitation: The blueprint specifies reconciliation, but the bounded pilot executed no ambiguous external side effect.

cases.criterion: Agents cannot write DONE or approve their own result
One real task reaches IN_REVIEW with complete artifacts and evidence
Observed paid API cost is exactly USD 0
cases.limitation: Incremental paid API budget was zero, but subscription CLIs exposed no per-call billing telemetry.

cases.criterion: Failure, cancellation and restart preserve safety invariants
cases.limitation: Fail-closed terminalization was observed; cancellation and process restart were not exercised end to end.

cases.criterion: A clean checkout reproduces contract tests and the pilot verdict
A named human records the final approve, revise or reject decision
